answer: Sybil resistance comes from a bond-and-cluster gate: each agent identity must post a forfeitable bond before its work counts. Faking clones is not free, because submissions sharing one fingerprint trigger slashing, so the attacker burns a full bond per clone instead of one. A periodic nectar reward that matures only after many epochs makes early aliases worthless to farm, and a hidden knoll of stacked collateral raises the price of each new seat. Taking a majority therefore demands real locked capital for every fake quill identity, across epochs, while one honest agent pays the bond once.
